name: book-summary
description: Turn an EPUB or PDF book into a templated summary (Markdown + PDF) and distribute it to Google Drive and an Obsidian vault.

interface.shortDescription: Summarize books to Markdown + PDF and file them.
interface.longDescription: Extracts text from an EPUB or PDF book, writes a structured summary from a fixed template in both Markdown and PDF, then copies both files to a configured Google Drive folder and (optionally) into an Obsidian vault with a Map-of-Content link.
interface.defaultPrompt: Summarize this book file into Markdown and PDF and file it in Drive and my vault.
